title: Taylor Swift Misses Best Pop Vocal Album as Raye Leads the 2027 Grammy Nominations

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to homepage Taylor Swift Misses Best Pop Vocal Album as Raye Leads the 2027 Grammy Nominations
 Maggie Clancy Mon, 16 November 2026 at 4:37 pm UTC 7 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Raye has never won a Grammy . On Monday, she picked up a staggering 11 nominations.
 The British singer leads the field for the 2027 Grammy Awards, tying Beyoncé Knowles-Carter's record for the most nominations received by a woman in a single year. Her sophomore album, "This Music May Contain Hope," is up for Album of the Year, while "Where Is My Husband!" is competing for both Record and Song of the Year.

 Raye performs onstage at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards held at Peacock Theater on Sept. 27 in Los Angeles.
 Rosalía isn't far behind with nine nominations, including Album of the Year for "Lux (Complete Works)." Her collaboration with Björk and Yves Tumor, "Berghain," is also up for Record and Song of the Year. The nominations follow a big week for the Spanish singer, who collected five awards at Thursday's Latin Grammys in Las Vegas.
 Rosalía accepts Song of the Year for "La Perla" at the 27th annual Latin Grammy Awards on Nov. 12 in Las Vegas.
 Taylor Swift , meanwhile, is back in the Album of the Year race with "The Life of a Showgirl," though the album was conspicuously absent from the Best Pop Vocal Album category.
 Taylor Swift performs onstage during the sixth annual Academy Museum Gala on Oct. 17 in Los Angeles.
 Swift earned five nominations overall, including Record of the Year for "The Fate of Ophelia" and Song of the Year for "I Knew It, I Knew You," her contribution to "Toy Story 5."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Country singer Ella Langley also had quite the morning. The "Choosin' Texas" singer earned seven nominations, becoming the first country artist since Bobbie Gentry in 1968 to compete in all four major categories in the same year: Album, Record and Song of the Year, and Best New Artist.
 Ella Langley performs at The 61st Academy of Country Music Awards on May 17, 2026 in Las Vegas.
 Olivia Rodrigo , Phoebe Bridgers and Miranda Lambert also earned seven nominations apiece, while Olivia Dean received six nominations for her second studio album, "The Art of Loving," including Record of the Year for "Man I Need."
 Knowles-Carter, already the most-nominated artist in Grammy history, added another milestone to her résumé. Her Best R&B Solo Performance nomination for "Morning Dew (Donk)" brings her career total to 100.
 Beyoncé Knowles-Carter performs with daughter, Blue Ivy, during the halftime show for the game between the Baltimore Ravens and the Houston Texans on Dec. 25, 2024, in Houston.
 There was some fashion-related news on the ballot, too. Lady Gaga and Doechii's "Runway" from "The Devil Wears Prada 2" received nominations for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance and Best Song Written for Visual Media. Charli XCX's "Music, Fashion, Film," also made the Best Alternative Music Album category.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Elsewhere, Madonna received several nominations, including Best Dance/Electronic Album for "Confessions II" and Best Pop Duo/Group Performance alongside Sabrina Carpenter for "Bring Your Love."
 Madonna and Charlie XCX at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards at the Peacock Theater on Sept. 27.
 The 69th Grammy Awards will take place Feb. 7 at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. The ceremony will air on ABC, with streaming available on Disney+ and Hulu.
 For those keeping track, here's a look at the nominees in 15 of the biggest categories, from Album of the Year to Best Song Written for Visual Media.
  2027 Grammy Nominations: Major Categories and Nominees 
 There's plenty more on the Grammy ballot. The Recording Academy announced nominations across 100 categories Monday, with everyone from Knowles-Carter and Madonna to Cardi B and Lady Gaga in the mix.
Below, a look at 15 of the bigger races, including Best Pop Vocal Album, where Taylor Swift's "The Life of a Showgirl" didn't make the cut.
